svg.title: Вращение грудного отдела на четвереньках — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Quadruped thoracic rotation, three-quarter front angle. Both knees and one straight supporting arm fixed on floor, free hand behind head. LEFT working elbow points down and toward support arm. RIGHT torso opens to side with working elbow pointing toward ceiling, hips remain square, supporting palm and both knees unmoved. Free hand remains behind head. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
